shortDescription: Configures rate limit on icx switch.

options.name: broadcast_limit
options.description: Configures the maximum number of broadcast packets allowed per second. Enables Syslog logging of broadcast packets.

options.name: check_running_config
options.description: Check running configuration. This can be set as environment variable. Module will use environment variable value, unless it is overridden, by specifying it as module parameter.

options.name: multicast_limit
options.description: Configures the maximum number of multicast packets allowed per second. Enables Syslog logging of multicast packets.

options.name: rate_limit_arp
options.description: Limits the number of ARP packets the Ruckus device accepts during each second.

options.name: rate_limit_bum
options.description: Configures the global level BUM suppression logging interval. The default logging interval 5 minutes

options.name: rate_limit_output
options.description: Configures the maximum rate at which outbound traffic is sent on a port priority queue or on a LAG port.

options.name: unknown_unicast_limit
options.description: Configures the maximum number of unknown unicast packets allowed per second. Enables Syslog logging of unknown unicast packets.
